entries.9f8bdc1cfc759ec1: Since its founding in 1945, the company has accumulated industrial furnace technology, and in 1954 it introduced state-of-the-art industrial furnace technology through a technical tie-up with a U.S. company. Using the 'Thermal Technology Creation Center' at the Sakai Works as its R&D base, it is developing decarbonization technologies, including hydrogen and ammonia combustion and electrification, and is also working to expand its lineup of hydrogen burners. In February 2025, the company received a commendation from Toyota Motor for its hydrogen-combustion afterburner furnace.
entries.a3c951f8ab8c2957: Centered on 'thermal technology', its basic philosophy is to respond accurately to social demands such as effective use of energy and conservation of the global environment, while creating new value in advanced fields and contributing to the development of society. The Medium-Term Management Plan 'Chugai Ro Break Through(CBT)2022-2026' sets Management Vision 2026 'Transform ourselves and open the future with carbon-neutral technology!' and promotes three key strategies: creating new markets centered on carbon neutrality, expanding sales of existing products by refining them to fit customer needs, and building a rewarding workplace.
